map.简易法：客单价、年频次、生命周期、毛利率四要素: Simple method: the four elements of order value, annual frequency, lifetime and gross margin
map.订阅法：月收入、毛利率、月流失率三要素: Subscription method: the three elements of monthly revenue, gross margin and monthly churn
map.自动给出 LTV/CAC 比值，判断是否健康（通常 > 3）: Automatically gives the LTV/CAC ratio and judges whether it is healthy (usually above 3)
map.内置行业 LTV 范围参考表: Built-in industry LTV range reference table
map.结果可切换查看明细: The result can be switched to show details
map.评估获客预算：对比 LTV 与 CAC: Evaluate the acquisition budget: compare LTV with CAC
map.订阅业务：用流失率估算客户长期价值: Subscription businesses: estimate long-term customer value from churn rate
map.经营复盘：看毛利率变化对 LTV 的影响: Business review: see how gross margin changes affect LTV
map.简易法填客单价、年购买频次、生命周期、毛利率: For the simple method fill in order value, annual purchase frequency, lifetime and gross margin
map.订阅法填月收入、毛利率、月流失率，以及 CAC: For the subscription method fill in monthly revenue, gross margin, monthly churn and CAC
map.点击「计算」得到 LTV 与 LTV/CAC: Click "calculate" to get LTV and LTV/CAC
map.对照行业范围判断是否健康: Check against industry ranges to judge health

map.毛利率对 LTV 影响很大，先校准毛利率: Gross margin greatly affects LTV, so calibrate it first
